reason: An MCP bridge for discovering, inspecting, optionally installing, and running DeepSeek Harness plugins, with installation and runtime execution explicitly opt-in.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 搜索、检查并可选安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件，并在启用运行时后调用其工具。
summaries.en: An MCP bridge for searching and inspecting DeepSeek Harness plugins, optionally installing them, and calling their tools when runtime access is enabled.

capabilities: Searches and inspects public GitHub dsh-plugin repositories
Installs and uninstalls DSH plugins in a configured profile when enabled
Starts and stops a DSH runtime and exposes its composition tools through MCP
Invokes installed plugin code when runtime access is enabled
Provides stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints
